title: Massachusetts Schedule II and III consumer education pamphlet
rule_summary: Massachusetts requires the designated consumer educational pamphlet when a pharmacy dispenses a narcotic or controlled substance in Schedule II or III, subject to statutory exceptions including outpatient palliative care, long-term-care residents, and treatment of substance use disorder or opioid dependence.
exam_relevance: Tests whether a pharmacist applies the education requirement and its statutory indication/setting exceptions to the actual dispensing encounter.
exceptions: Outpatient palliative care; resident of a long-term care facility; drug prescribed for substance use disorder or opioid-dependence treatment.
common_confusions: Assuming every Schedule II or III dispensing requires the pamphlet without checking the statutory exception.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
